name: NDCG@10
expansion: Normalised Discounted Cumulative Gain at rank 10
one_line: Discounted cumulative gain over graded relevance, normalised against the ideal ranking.

formula.notation:
DCG@k = sum_i (2^grade(c_i) - 1) / log2(i + 1)
NDCG@k = DCG@k / IDCG@k

terms.meaning: DCG of the best possible ordering

range.note: Mathematical range. No typical value is stated: it would be a number with no run behind it.

ci.why: A point estimate over a few hundred queries without an interval is the first thing a reviewer attacks.
